Taxes and fees at Galveston hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at Comfort Inn & Suites Galveston Central Island near Pier to 16% at Comfort Suites Galveston Cruise Port Area - Beachside. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
